tools.name: memra_remember
tools.description: Store one or many memories in Memra. Single mode: pass content + namespace. Decision mode: pass type=decision with content + namespace (optionally context). Pattern mode: pass type=pattern with title + steps + namespace. Bulk mode: pass entries[]. If the response contains conflicts[], the new fact c

tools.name: memra_recall
tools.description: Search memories in Memra by semantic similarity. Returns ranked results by relevance. Replaces memra_search.

tools.name: memra_get
tools.description: Get a single memory by ID with full content. Use when you need the complete text of a memory (search results are truncated).

tools.name: memra_list
tools.description: List memories in Memra for a namespace. Returns paginated results with filtering options.

tools.name: memra_supersede
tools.description: Replace a memory with new content. The old memory is marked superseded and stops appearing in search; the new memory inherits the old memory's type, importance, tags, source and metadata unless overridden. Works for all memory types (use this instead of memra_add when you are correcting or updating

tools.name: memra_history
tools.description: View the full supersession chain for a memory (oldest to newest). tools.name: memra_bootstrap
tools.description: Load agent bootstrap context from Memra. Returns priority-ordered memories for agent session initialization.
